scientific_limitations: Exact for independent-edge Erdős–Rényi graphs and one absent edge only; asymptotic holds with fixed motif size. Earlier general subgraph-count moment machinery might imply some formulas; full original 2008 article and Janson 1990 text not obtained. No independent validation.
title: A single density reversal in the covariance of induced cliques and one-edge-defect cliques
